description: Player profile with summary: ready paragraphs from our data (club, season numbers, form; English, no lang; summary_as_of; absent when not fresh or for a player under 18); position, nationality, birth date, height, team, career and photo link where known; cricket and tennis also Wikidata values (birth date, height, batting or playing hand, bowling style, role, country; cite the attribution); tennis also the ATP/WTA rank and season_stats: the season record (current year, or season) from our singles main-draw matches since 2026-04-01 (won, lost, per surface and level, retirements counted, walkovers not, finals, titles), or with vs the head-to-head of two players; soccer also bio: known_as, full_name, short_name, birth_date, age, nationality, position, number, club, market_value_eur (null = not in our data; there are no contract dates), and season_stats: the current season (or season) in every competition we hold statistics for, total and per competition (apps, minutes, goals, assists, cards, shots, rating; null = not in our data; matches_with_stats of team_matches_played says how complete it is); with matches, last_matches: the player's last N matches (date, league, opponent, venue, score, result, started, minutes, goals, assists, cards, shots, rating, goalkeepers conceded and clean sheet; null = not in our data; matches without statistics or that he missed are not listed); NBA, MLB and NFL players also season_stats: the season line per team from the data provider's team feeds (stats by category as the feed names them; season null for the NBA, whose feed names none, as_of when read); WNBA, NCAA and hockey (NHL, Liiga, SHL, DEL) players the same, summed from our box scores; with matches, US-sport players (NBA, WNBA, NCAA, MLB, NFL, NHL) last_matches: the last N games from our box scores (date, league, opponent, venue, score, result, stats by category as in season_stats but per game; null = not in the box); handball players (Swedish and Austrian lower leagues) the same season_stats from the federations' player statistics and match reports (null = not in our data).

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

matches.description: soccer, NBA, MLB, NFL, NHL (and WNBA, NCAA): also last_matches, the player's last N matches or games (1-50) with his line in each

player_id.description: player code (or number) from a squad or lineup

season.description: soccer: season_stats of this season (2025-26, or 2025) instead of the current one; tennis: a year (2026)

vs.description: tennis: another player's id, for the head-to-head of the two instead

name: get_player
